履修条件
Graduate students who can access internet and have an undergraduate-level background in science and engineering.
授業概要
このコースの履修により、大学院生は材料、エネルギー、環境分野におけるトピックを学ぶ。このコースは 4 つのトピックで構成され、九州大学、釜山国立大学 (韓国)、上海交通大学 (中国)、マレーシア工科大学 (マレーシア) の講師団によってオンラインで開講する。
このコースは英語のみでZoomを使用してオンラインで行う。 Zoomの情報はMoodleシステム上でお知らせする。
In this course, graduate students will gain an overall understanding of the fields of energy and environmental science and technology (EEST). Students will study EEST-related topics in material, energy, and environment fields. This course is composed of 4 topics and will be given online by professors from Kyushu University (KU, Japan), Pusan National University (PNU, Korea), Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU, China), and University of Technology Malaysia (UTM, Malaysia).
This course will be given online through Zoom in English only. The Zoom information will be announced on Moodle system.

全体の教育目標
The overall aim of this course is for students to learn about topical issues as well as fundamental concepts in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology.
個別の教育目標
This course is specifically aimed at helping students to broaden their horizons and improve their ability to understand and discuss research topics in the fields of energy and environmental science and engineering in an informative, engaging and professional manner.
授業計画
4 lectures, on Jun. 11, 2026, Jun. 18, 2026, Jun. 25, 2026, and Jul. 2, 2026, 14:50-17:50 (GMT+9 = Japan & Korea), 13:50-16:50 (GMT+8, China & Malaysia)
The detailed course content will be updated on the Moodle system.

授業の進め方
The online lectures will be given by using the ''Zoom Video Communications''. The Zoom information will be announced on Moodle system.
Lectures will consist of PowerPoint presentations on the major topics along with group discussions as well as student presentations (if necessary). The overall score will be calculated based on the assessments done by all professors.
